children: Wealth platform Hub24 is winning where it matters, says its bull at Jefferies. It achieved adviser growth, new licensee wins, and market-share expansion in 1Q. Platform funds under administration rose 18% on year to A$143.7 billion while total funds under administration reached A$168.6 billion. Those are solid outcomes, analyst Simon Fitzgerald says. Jefferies notes Hub24's stock has fallen 25% since its FY26 result in August. "We believe an attractive entry price has emerged," Jefferies says. "Our downside target of A$60.00 assumes a 7.5% terminal Market Share and compares to Hub24's current share of 10.1%." Hub24 ended Tuesday at A$67.08. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
